claims: Artemis II is scheduled to return to Earth on Friday, April 10, 2026.
Artemis II is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, CA.
Artemis II lunar flyby is on April 6, 2026.
Artemis II has a four-person crew.
The goal of Artemis II is testing the Orion spacecraft systems with crew for the first time.
The Artemis II capsule and crew will be recovered by US Navy and NASA teams after splashing down
